description: This file contains the implementation of a PKI entity for certificate and key management, including key pair generation, certificate signing, export/import, and cryptographic operations. It provides functionalities for creating, removing, and manipulating certificates and keys, supporting various cryptographic APIs and certificate formats.

methods.name: void InitPKIEntityAPIs(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for PKI entity operations within the object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreatePKIEntity(ANSC_HANDLE hContext,ANSC_HANDLE hCertAttr,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new PKI entity, initializing key pair, certificate request, and self-signed certificate functionalities.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreatePKIEntityWithCryptoAPI(ANSC_HANDLE hContext,ANSC_HANDLE hCertAttr,ANSC_HANDLE hCryptoAPI,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity using a provided cryptographic API, supporting hardware tokens or smartcards.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreatePKIEntityWithCert(ANSC_HANDLE hContext,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,ANSC_HANDLE hCertAttr,PUCHAR pEncodingCert,ULONG lenOfCert,PUCHAR pPriKeyInfoEncode,ULONG lenOfKey)
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity from existing certificate and private key encodings.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreatePKIEntityWithKeyPair(ANSC_HANDLE hContext,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,PCHAR pDNName,ULONG keyType,ANSC_HANDLE hKeyPair)
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity with an existing key pair and optional distinguished name.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS removeAllCAs(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes all CA certificates associated with the entity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntityRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the PKI entity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntityRemoveEntityCert(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes the entity's certificate.

methods.name: ULONG PKIEntityGetCACount(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Returns the number of CA certificates associated.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PKIEntityGetCAByIndex(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulIndex)
methods.description: Retrieves a CA certificate by index.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PKIEntityCreatePKCS10(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Creates a PKCS#10 certificate signing request handle.

methods.name: PUCHAR PKIEntityCreatePKCS10Encoding(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PULONG pLength)
methods.description: Generates encoding for a PKCS#10 request.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PKIEntityGetEntityCert(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the entity's certificate handle.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntitySetCertHandle(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCert)
methods.description: Sets the certificate handle for the entity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntitySetIssuedCert(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pEncoding,ULONG length)
methods.description: Assigns an issued certificate to the entity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntitySetPrivateKeyInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pPriKeyInfoEncode,ULONG length)
methods.description: Sets the private key information from ASN.1 encoding.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntityIssueCert(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hUserObject,ULONG nYears,ULONG ulKeyUsage,BOOLEAN bAddSubKeyIdenExtension,BOOLEAN bIsCA,LONG pathLength)
methods.description: Issues a new certificate to a user entity, supporting CA attributes and extensions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntityExportInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID * ppCertEncoding,PULONG pLenOfCert,PVOID * ppPriKeyInfo,PULONG pLenOfKeyInfo)
methods.description: Exports the entity's certificate and private key information.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PKIEntityExportToFile(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PCHAR pCertFile,PCHAR pKeyInfoFile)
methods.description: Writes the certificate and key to specified files.

methods.name: PCHAR PKIEntityGetName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
